en.t: 1. In a large saucepan, toast peppercorns, cumin seeds, and cloves over medium heat until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add chicken stock, tomatoes, tomatillos, guajillo, California, and árbol chiles. Bring to a boil over high heat, then turn off the heat, and let rest until tomato skins begin to shrivel and chiles soften, about 15 minutes.
2. Transfer chicken stock mixture to a blender. Crumble achiote paste into the blender by hand. Add gochujang and garlic cloves and blend (in batches if needed) into a smooth puree. Set aside.

3. Generously season beef all over with salt and pepper. In a stock pot or large Dutch oven, add the beef, blended chile sauce, water, onion, and bay leaves and cook over medium-high heat, covered, until just simmering.

4. Continue to cook, covered, reducing heat as needed to maintain gentle simmer (about 82–88 °C), until beef is fork-tender, 3 to 4 hours. Discard onion and bay leaves and season with salt and pepper to taste. Hold warm until ready to serve.

5. For Serving: Using a slotted spoon, transfer beef to a cutting board. Using 2 forks, shred beef into bite-sized pieces or lightly chop. Ladle consomé into individual serving bowls and top consomé with diced onion and cilantro (this is for dunking and/or spooning over the meat). Serve shredded beef with prepared consomé, warm tortillas, rice, beans, and lime wedges.

1. Vo veľkom kastróli opražíme na strednom ohni zrnká korenia, celú rímsku rascu (kmín) a klinčeky, kým nezavoňajú, asi 30 sekúnd. Pridáme kurací vývar, paradajky, tomatillos a papričky guajillo, California a árbol. Na silnom ohni privedieme do varu, potom sporák vypneme a necháme postáť, kým sa šupky paradajok nezačnú zvrašťovať a papričky nezmäknú, asi 15 minút.
2. Zmes s vývarom preložíme do mixéra. Rukami do nej rozdrobíme pastu achiote. Pridáme gochujang a strúčiky cesnaku a rozmixujeme (podľa potreby po dávkach) na hladké pyré. Odložíme.

3. Hovädzie mäso zo všetkých strán bohato osolíme a okoreníme. Do veľkého hrnca alebo liatinového hrnca dáme mäso, rozmixovanú papričkovú omáčku, vodu, cibuľu a bobkové listy a na stredne silnom až silnom ohni pod pokrievkou privedieme do mierneho varu.

4. Pod pokrievkou varíme ďalej a podľa potreby stlmíme oheň, aby sa zmes len mierne varila (asi 82 – 88 °C), kým mäso nie je mäkké na vidličku, 3 až 4 hodiny. Cibuľu a bobkové listy vyhodíme a podľa chuti osolíme a okoreníme. Do podávania udržiavame teplé.

5. **NA PODÁVANIE:** Dierovanou lyžicou preložíme mäso na dosku. Dvoma vidličkami ho natrháme na kúsky veľkosti sústa alebo zľahka nasekáme. Vývar (consomé) naberačkou rozdelíme do misiek a posypeme nakrájanou cibuľou a koriandrovou vňaťou (na namáčanie mäsa alebo na jeho polievanie). Natrhané mäso podávame s pripraveným vývarom, teplými tortillami, ryžou, fazuľou a mesiačikmi limetky.

en.t: 1. Adjust broiler rack to 20 cm below element and preheat broiler to high. Place poblanos, onion, tomatillos, serranos, and garlic on a foil-lined rimmed baking sheet. Place under broiler and broil, turning vegetables occasionally, until tomatillos are completely softened and lightly charred, about 10 minutes. Transfer tomatillos to a bowl. Continue broiling until poblanos are charred on all sides, about 2 minutes longer. Transfer to a separate bowl and cover tightly with foil. Continue broiling until onion, serranos, and garlic are softened and charred, about 5 minutes longer. Transfer to bowl with tomatillos along with any juices and set aside.

2. Adjust oven rack to middle position and set oven to 190 °C (fan 170 °C). Add chicken stock to bowl with poblanos and peel poblanos while submerged in stock. Transfer flesh to bowl with tomatillos, leaving skin and seeds with the stock. Strain the stock through a fine-mesh strainer into the bowl with the tomatillo/pepper mixture. Discard skins and seeds. Add cilantro to mixture. Set mixture aside.

3. Season chicken pieces on all sides with salt and pepper. Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over high heat until shimmering. Add chicken skin side-down and cook without moving until well browned on first side, about 6 minutes. Flip chicken and continue cooking until lightly browned on second side, about 2 minutes longer. Transfer chicken to a bowl and pour off excess fat from Dutch oven, reserving any brown liquid.

4. Add tomatillo/pepper mixture to the Dutch oven and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom. Using an immersion blender, purée mixture into a chunky sauce. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Return chicken to pot, bring to a simmer, cover with lid slightly ajar, and simmer until chicken is cooked through, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, wrap tortillas in aluminum foil and place in oven to warm.

5. When chicken is cooked, remove from heat and transfer chicken to a large bowl using tongs. Allow to rest until cool enough to handle. Shred chicken into thin strips, discarding skin and bones. Add 235 ml of sauce, half of cheese, and half of Mexican crema to chicken and toss to combine. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

6. Remove tortillas from oven and unwrap. Spread 1/3 of the remaining sauce in the bottom of a 33 × 23 cm casserole dish. Dip each tortilla in the remaining sauce and stack on a cutting board. Working one tortilla at at time, place 2 tbsp (30 ml) of chicken filling in a line down the center and roll up tightly. Place in the casserole dish seam side-down. Continue until all the tortillas and filling are used (the casserole will be tightly packed).

7. Spread remaining sauce on top of enchiladas and lay remaining cheese down in a line through the middle of each row of enchiladas. Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake for 15 minutes. Remove foil and continue baking until cheese is lightly browned and bubbly, about 10 minutes longer.
8. Remove enchiladas from oven, drizzle with remaining crema, sprinkle with chopped cilantro, and serve immediately.

1. Rošt pod grilom nastavíme 20 cm od špirály a gril rozohrejeme na najvyšší stupeň. Papriky poblano, cibuľu, tomatillos, papričky serrano a cesnak rozložíme na plech s okrajom vystlaný alobalom. Dáme pod gril a grilujeme, zeleninu občas obrátime, kým tomatillos úplne nezmäknú a zľahka sa neopália, asi 10 minút. Tomatillos preložíme do misy. Grilujeme ďalej, kým papriky poblano nie sú opálené zo všetkých strán, ešte asi 2 minúty. Preložíme ich do samostatnej misy a pevne prikryjeme alobalom. Grilujeme ďalej, kým cibuľa, papričky serrano a cesnak nezmäknú a neopália sa, ešte asi 5 minút. Preložíme ich k tomatillos aj so šťavou a odložíme.

2. Rošt dáme do stredu rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 190 °C (teplovzdušnú na 170 °C). Do misy s paprikami poblano nalejeme kurací vývar a papriky ošúpeme ponorené vo vývare. Dužinu preložíme k tomatillos, šupky a semienka necháme vo vývare. Vývar precedíme cez jemné sitko do misy so zmesou tomatillos a paprík. Šupky a semienka vyhodíme. Do zmesi pridáme koriandrovú vňať. Zmes odložíme.

3. Kúsky kuracieho mäsa zo všetkých strán osolíme a okoreníme. Vo veľkom liatinovom hrnci zohrejeme na silnom ohni olej, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Vložíme kura kožou nadol a bez pohybovania opekáme, kým z prvej strany pekne nezhnedne, asi 6 minút. Obrátime a opekáme, kým zľahka nezhnedne aj z druhej strany, ešte asi 2 minúty. Kura preložíme do misy, z hrnca zlejeme prebytočný tuk a prípadnú hnedú šťavu necháme v hrnci.

4. Do hrnca pridáme zmes tomatillos a paprík a zoškrabeme pripečené zvyšky z dna. Ponorným mixérom rozmixujeme na hrubšiu omáčku. Podľa chuti osolíme a okoreníme. Kura vrátime do hrnca, privedieme do mierneho varu, prikryjeme pokrievkou s malou škárou a dusíme, kým nie je kura prepečené, asi 15 minút. Medzitým tortilly zabalíme do alobalu a vložíme ich do rúry zohriať.

5. Keď je kura hotové, odstavíme hrniec z ohňa a kliešťami preložíme kura do veľkej misy. Necháme postáť, kým nevychladne natoľko, aby sme ho mohli chytiť. Mäso natrháme na tenké pásiky, kožu a kosti vyhodíme. K mäsu pridáme 235 ml omáčky, polovicu syra a polovicu mexickej smotany crema a premiešame. Podľa chuti osolíme a okoreníme.

6. Tortilly vyberieme z rúry a rozbalíme. Tretinu zvyšnej omáčky rozotrieme na dno zapekacej misy 33 × 23 cm. Každú tortillu namočíme do zvyšnej omáčky a poukladáme ich na seba na dosku. Po jednej tortille do stredu nanesieme v pruhu 2 PL (30 ml) kuracej plnky a pevne zrolujeme. Vložíme do zapekacej misy spojom nadol. Pokračujeme, kým nespotrebujeme všetky tortilly a plnku (budú v mise natesno).

7. Zvyšnú omáčku rozotrieme na enchiladas a zvyšný syr rozložíme v pruhu stredom každého radu. Pevne prikryjeme alobalom a pečieme 15 minút. Alobal odstránime a pečieme ďalej, kým syr zľahka nezhnedne a nebublá, ešte asi 10 minút.
8. Enchiladas vyberieme z rúry, pokvapkáme zvyšnou smotanou crema, posypeme nasekanou koriandrovou vňaťou a hneď podávame.

en.t: 1. Make the curtido: In a large bowl, toss the cabbage, onion, carrot, and jalapeño (if using). In a small saucepan, heat the vinegar, salt, and sugar over medium heat, stirring, until just dissolved. Pour over the vegetables, toss, cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

2. Make the masa: In a mixing bowl, whisk the masa harina, flour, baking powder, and salt. Drizzle the oil evenly over the dry ingredients and whisk again until the mixture forms pea-sized balls. Add the water and mix thoroughly with a wooden spoon, then knead briefly by hand until it comes together in a smooth ball, about 2 minutes. Cover with a towel and let rest for 15 minutes.

3. Using wet hands, roll masa dough into 15 golf-ball-sized balls. Place balls on a baking sheet and cover with a moist towel. Working with one ball at a time, use your thumb to press a deep indent into the ball, then use your hands to work it into a small "bowl" with a 0.5 cm-thick edge.

4. Place about 1 heaping tbsp refried beans into the bottom of the "bowl," then top with about 1 heaping tbsp shredded cheese. Using moist fingers, carefully bring dough edge together, enclosing the filling within, and press to seal. Roll the ball in your hands to return it to a uniform ball shape. Carefully pat pupusa down into a flat round about 10 cm wide and about 2 cm thick; if edges crack, run a wet finger around them to smooth them. Place pupusas on a baking sheet and keep covered with a towel as you work. Repeat with remaining masa balls and fillings.

5. Lightly coat a large cast iron skillet with oil and heat over medium heat until shimmering. Working in batches, add pupusas and fry, turning once, until well-browned and crisp, about 4 minutes per side. Drain pupusas on a paper towel-lined plate, then transfer them to plates and top with curtido. Serve with hot sauce and lime wedges, if desired.

1. Make the curtido: In a large bowl, toss the cabbage, onion, carrot, and jalapeño (if using). In a small saucepan, heat the vinegar, salt, and sugar over medium heat, stirring, until just dissolved. Pour over the vegetables, toss, cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

2. Make the masa: In a mixing bowl, whisk the masa harina, flour, baking powder, and salt. Drizzle the oil evenly over the dry ingredients and whisk again until the mixture forms pea-sized balls. Add the water and mix thoroughly with a wooden spoon, then knead briefly by hand until it comes together in a smooth ball, about 2 minutes. Cover with a towel and let rest for 15 minutes.

3. Using wet hands, roll masa dough into 15 golf-ball-sized balls. Place balls on a baking sheet and cover with a moist towel. Working with one ball at a time, use your thumb to press a deep indent into the ball, then use your hands to work it into a small "bowl" with a 0.5 cm-thick edge.

4. Place about 1 heaping tbsp refried beans into the bottom of the "bowl," then top with about 1 heaping tbsp shredded cheese. Using moist fingers, carefully bring dough edge together, enclosing the filling within, and press to seal. Roll the ball in your hands to return it to a uniform ball shape. 1. **NA ČIERNU FAZUĽU:** V strednom kastróli zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni rastlinný olej, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme cibuľu, jalapeño, koriandrovú vňať a rímsku rascu (kmín). Prikryjeme a varíme, podľa potreby dolievame vodu, aby bola fazuľa stále tesne ponorená, kým fazuľa nezmäkne a tekutina nezačne mierne hustnúť, asi 40 minút. Preložíme na tanier vystlaný papierovými utierkami a hneď osolíme. Zopakujeme so zvyšnými tortillami. Vychladnuté tostadas vydržia v uzavretej nádobe najviac 3 dni.

3. Pred podávaním rozdelíme tostadas na 4 taniere; skôr než začneme opekať vajcia, máme pripravenú teplú fazuľu, avokádo a ozdoby. Vo veľkej nepriľnavej alebo liatinovej panvici zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni trochu rastlinného oleja; keď olej začne dymiť, pridáme toľko vajec, koľko sa do panvice zmestí bez preplnenia. en.t: 1. For the Salsa: Adjust oven rack to upper-middle position and preheat oven broiler to high. Place tomatillos and garlic on an aluminum foil–lined baking sheet. Broil until garlic is blackened and well charred, 3 minutes. Remove garlic, flip tomatillos, and continue broiling until tomatillos are deeply charred, about 5 more minutes.
2. In a blender jar, add charred tomatillo, garlic, and chiles. Blend on high speed until smooth, adding 1 to 2 tbsp (15–30 ml) of water, if needed, about 1 minute. Season with salt to taste.

3. For the Chicken Filling: In a large saucepan, add olive oil and heat over medium heat until shimmering. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly softened, about 5 minutes. Add tomato, serrano chiles, and garlic and continue cooking until tomatoes and chiles have softened, about 5 more minutes. Turn off heat and stir in shredded chicken.

4. For the Chimichangas: Add oil to large Dutch oven or stock pot. (Oil should measure 5 cm deep.) Heat over medium-high until oil reaches 175 °C. While oil is heating, working with one tortilla at a time, spread (45 g) shredded cheese just below center of tortilla in the shape of a rectangle, leaving a 5 cm border on the left and right sides and a 7.5 cm border on the bottom and top sides. Top cheese with a chicken mixture and mold it with your fingers into a neat cylindrical shape over the cheese. Place (77 g) rice over chicken filling and use fingers to spread out to cover filling.

5. Fold the 2 short sides of tortilla in over the filling. Then pull one long side over the center and tuck it beneath the fillings with your fingertips. Hold the sides tight and roll until burrito is sealed and fillings fully tucked in.

6. When ready to fry and oil reaches temperature, line a wire rack with paper towels and set in a rimmed baking sheet. Using a spider skimmer, large metal slotted spoon, or metal fish spatula, carefully transfer two chimichangas into hot oil, seam side down, and fry until bottom sides are golden brown, about 2 minutes. Using spider skimmer or tongs, gently flip and continue frying until tortilla is crisp and golden on all sides, about 2 minutes longer. Transfer to prepared wire rack when done. Return oil to 175 °C. Repeat frying process with remaining chimichangas. Let fried chimichangas sit for 5 minutes to slightly cool.

1. **NA SALSU:** Rošt dáme do hornej tretiny rúry a gril rozohrejeme na najvyšší stupeň. Tomatillos a cesnak rozložíme na plech vystlaný alobalom. Grilujeme, kým cesnak nesčernie a dobre sa neopáli, 3 minúty. Cesnak vyberieme, tomatillos obrátime a grilujeme ďalej, kým nie sú silno opálené, ešte asi 5 minút.
2. Do nádoby mixéra dáme opálené tomatillos, cesnak a čili papričky. Rozmixujeme na vysokých otáčkach dohladka, asi 1 minútu, a podľa potreby pridáme 1 až 2 PL (15 – 30 ml) vody. Podľa chuti osolíme.

3. **NA KURACIU PLNKU:** Vo veľkom kastróli zohrejeme na strednom ohni olivový olej, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme cibuľu a za občasného miešania ju opekáme, kým mierne nezmäkne, asi 5 minút. Pridáme paradajku, papričky serrano a cesnak a opekáme, kým paradajky a papričky nezmäknú, ešte asi 5 minút. Sporák vypneme a vmiešame natrhané kuracie mäso.

4. **NA CHIMICHANGAS:** Do veľkého liatinového hrnca alebo hrnca na vývar nalejeme olej (vrstva má byť hlboká 5 cm). Zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni na 175 °C. Kým sa olej zohrieva, po jednej tortille rozložíme tesne pod jej stred obdĺžnik zo 45 g nastrúhaného syra, s okrajom 5 cm vľavo a vpravo a 7,5 cm hore a dole. Na syr dáme kuraciu zmes a prstami ju vytvarujeme do úhľadného valčeka. Na kuraciu plnku dáme 77 g ryže a prstami ju rozotrieme, aby plnku zakryla.

5. Kratšie strany tortilly preložíme cez plnku. Potom pretiahneme jednu dlhšiu stranu cez stred a končekmi prstov ju zastrčíme pod plnku. Boky pevne držíme a zrolujeme, kým nie je burrito uzavreté a plnka celkom zabalená.

6. Keď je olej zohriaty na požadovanú teplotu, mriežku vystelieme papierovými utierkami a vložíme ju do plechu s okrajom. Cedidlovou naberačkou, veľkou kovovou dierovanou lyžicou alebo kovovou obracačkou na ryby opatrne vložíme do horúceho oleja dve chimichangas spojom nadol a vyprážame, kým spodná strana nie je zlatohnedá, asi 2 minúty. Cedidlovou naberačkou alebo kliešťami jemne obrátime a vyprážame ďalej, kým tortilla nie je chrumkavá a zlatistá zo všetkých strán, ešte asi 2 minúty. Hotové preložíme na pripravenú mriežku. Olej znova zohrejeme na 175 °C. Takto vypražíme zvyšné chimichangas. Vyprážané chimichangas necháme 5 minút mierne vychladnúť.
7. Chimichangas podávame so salsou, smotanou crema, guacamole, pico de gallo a mesiačikmi limetky.

en.t: 1. For the stock: Preheat the oven to 260 °C (fan 240 °C). Spread the chicken wings in a rimmed baking sheet and bake until deeply golden brown, about 40 minutes. Pour off any rendered chicken fat and reserve for cooking.

2. Transfer the wings from the roasting pan to a stock pot. Add 235 ml of water to the roasting pan and scrape up any brown bits with a wooden spoon. Pour the water and brown bits to a stockpot. Add enough water to cover the wings and simmer for 3 1/2 hours, adding more water if needed to keep chicken wings submerged. (Alternatively, simmer the wings in a pressure cooker at full pressure for 1 1/2 hours.)
3. Add the onion, garlic, and bell pepper to the stock and simmer an additional 30 minutes. Strain the stock and reduce further or add more water until the yield is 1180 ml.

4. For the stew: Add the chicken fat to a 6910 ml Dutch oven or similar heavy-bottomed, oven-safe pot and heat over medium-high until the fat shimmers. Season chicken thighs with salt and sear, skin side down, until golden brown, about 4 minutes. Flip chicken and sear on other side until browned, about 4 minutes longer. Transfer chicken to a plate and set aside. Drain any excess fat from pot and lower heat to medium.

5. Add diced onion and minced garlic to pot and cook, scraping up any browned bits from the chicken, until translucent and tender, about 5 minutes. Add aji panca or cayenne, cumin, paprika, oregano, and black pepper and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.

6. Increase heat to high, then add chicken wing stock, diced potato, and raisins and bring to a simmer. Season with salt. Return chicken thighs to pot along with any accumulated juices. Reduce heat to low. Cover and gently simmer until chicken has cooked through, about 30 minutes.

7. Remove the stew from heat and set aside until the chicken is cool enough to handle, about 1 hour (The chicken should be left to cool in the stew so that it doesn't dry out.) Using your hands, pick the meat from the chicken thighs and break into small pieces, discarding the skin and bones. Stir peas and picked chicken meat into the stew and refrigerate until the stew has solidified, about 4 hours, preferably overnight, and up to 3 days in advance.
8. For the dough: In a 1820 ml saucepan, combine butter and annatto and melt to infuse the butter with color.

9. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, and sugar. Pour the melted butter into the flour mixture and, using your hands, mix until thoroughly combined and sandy. Add 177 ml hot water to the flour mixture and mix until the dough comes together into a smooth ball.
10. Divide the dough into 9 equal portions (about 100 g each). Fold each portion of dough onto itself until it becomes smooth and pat into a disk. Cover with plastic wrap.

11. Assembly: Work with one portion of dough at a time, keeping the remaining pieces covered. Lightly dust your work surface with flour. Using a rolling pin, roll out one portion of dough into a 20 cm round about 0.5 cm thick. Loosen the dough from the work surface with an offset spatula.

12. Add 1/9 (about 235 ml) of the chilled chicken stew to the center of the dough. Top it with a quarter of a hardboiled egg and two black olive halves. Brush the edges of the dough with egg white. Join the edges of the dough together over the filling. Press the edges together to encase the filling into a large football with a seam running across the top. Crimp the edges and transfer the salteña to a parchment-lined rimmed baking sheet. Repeat with the remaining dough and filling. Freeze the formed salteñas before baking at least 1 hour and up to 3 months in advance. (If freezing long-term, once the salteñas are fully frozen, wrap each in plastic and transfer to a zip lock freezer bag to prevent freezer burn.)

13. Baking: If the salteñas have been frozen for only 1 hour, preheat your oven to 260 °C (fan 240 °C). If the salteñas have been frozen solid for 4 hours or more, preheat your oven to 230 °C (fan 210 °C). Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment and spray lightly with cooking spray. Line the tray with the frozen salteñas. (Do not bake on the chilled baking sheet the salteñas were frozen on or the bottom of the pastry will not brown.) Brush the pastries with egg white and bake until the seam is blackened and the crust is golden brown, 15-20 minutes. Serve immediately.

1. **NA VÝVAR:** Rúru rozohrejeme na 260 °C (teplovzdušnú na 240 °C). Kuracie krídla rozložíme na plech s okrajom a pečieme, kým nie sú sýto zlatohnedé, asi 40 minút. Vypečený kurací tuk zlejeme a odložíme na varenie.

2. Krídla preložíme z plechu do hrnca na vývar. Na plech nalejeme 235 ml vody a varechou zoškrabeme pripečené zvyšky. Vodu so zvyškami prelejeme do hrnca. Dolejeme toľko vody, aby boli krídla ponorené, a mierne varíme 3½ hodiny; podľa potreby dolievame vodu, aby krídla zostali pod hladinou. (Krídla môžeme variť aj v tlakovom hrnci pri plnom tlaku 1½ hodiny.)
3. Do vývaru pridáme cibuľu, cesnak a papriku a mierne varíme ďalších 30 minút. Vývar precedíme a ďalej ho zredukujeme alebo dolejeme vodu, aby sme ho mali 1180 ml.

4. **NA DUSENÉ MÄSO:** Kurací tuk dáme do liatinového hrnca s objemom 6910 ml alebo podobného ťažkého hrnca vhodného do rúry a zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni, kým sa tuk nezačne lesknúť. Kuracie stehná osolíme a opečieme kožou nadol dozlatista, asi 4 minúty. Obrátime a opečieme aj z druhej strany, ešte asi 4 minúty. Kura preložíme na tanier a odložíme. Z hrnca zlejeme prebytočný tuk a oheň stlmíme na stredný.

5. Do hrnca pridáme nakrájanú cibuľu a nasekaný cesnak a opekáme, pričom zoškrabujeme pripečené zvyšky po kurati, kým cibuľa nie je sklovitá a mäkká, asi 5 minút. Pridáme ají panca alebo kajenské korenie, rímsku rascu (kmín), mletú papriku, oregano a čierne korenie a opekáme, kým nezavoňajú, asi 1 minútu.

6. Oheň zvýšime na silný, pridáme vývar z krídel, nakrájané zemiaky a hrozienka a privedieme do mierneho varu. Osolíme. Kuracie stehná vrátime do hrnca aj so šťavou. Oheň stlmíme na mierny. Prikryjeme a jemne dusíme, kým nie je kura prepečené, asi 30 minút.

7. Dusené mäso odstavíme z ohňa a necháme postáť, kým kura nevychladne natoľko, aby sme ho mohli chytiť, asi 1 hodinu (kura necháme chladnúť v omáčke, aby nevyschlo). Rukami oberieme mäso zo stehien a natrháme ho na malé kúsky, kožu a kosti vyhodíme. Do omáčky vmiešame hrášok a obrané mäso a dáme do chladničky, kým zmes nestuhne, asi 4 hodiny, najlepšie cez noc; môžeme ju pripraviť až 3 dni vopred.
8. **NA CESTO:** V kastróliku s objemom 1820 ml spojíme maslo a annatto (achiote) a zohrejeme, kým sa maslo nerozpustí a nezafarbí.

9. Vo veľkej mise metličkou zmiešame múku, soľ a cukor. Na múčnu zmes nalejeme rozpustené maslo a rukami premiešame, kým nie je zmes jednoliata a sypká ako piesok. Pridáme 177 ml horúcej vody a miešame, kým sa cesto nespojí do hladkej gule.
10. Cesto rozdelíme na 9 rovnakých dielov (asi po 100 g). Každý diel niekoľkokrát preložíme, kým nie je hladký, a rozpleštíme na disk. Prikryjeme fóliou.

11. **SKLADANIE:** Pracujeme vždy s jedným dielom cesta, ostatné necháme prikryté. Pracovnú plochu zľahka poprášime múkou. Valčekom rozvaľkáme jeden diel cesta na kruh s priemerom 20 cm a hrúbkou asi 0,5 cm. Lomenou stierkou cesto uvoľníme z pracovnej plochy.

12. Do stredu cesta dáme deviatinu (asi 235 ml) vychladenej kuracej zmesi. Navrch položíme štvrtinu natvrdo uvareného vajca a dve polovice čiernych olív. Okraje cesta potrieme bielkom. Okraje spojíme nad plnkou. Pritlačíme ich, aby plnka bola uzavretá vo veľkej šiške v tvare rugbyovej lopty so spojom navrchu. Okraje ozdobne zatlačíme a salteñu preložíme na plech s okrajom vystlaný papierom na pečenie. Zopakujeme so zvyšným cestom a plnkou. Vytvarované salteñas pred pečením zmrazíme, aspoň na 1 hodinu a najviac 3 mesiace vopred. (Ak ich mrazíme dlhšie, po úplnom zmrazení každú zabalíme do fólie a vložíme do uzatvárateľného mraziaceho vrecka, aby sa nevysušili.)

13. **PEČENIE:** Ak boli salteñas v mrazničke len 1 hodinu, rúru rozohrejeme na 260 °C (teplovzdušnú na 240 °C). Ak boli zmrazené natvrdo 4 hodiny a viac, rúru rozohrejeme na 230 °C (teplovzdušnú na 210 °C). Plech s okrajom vystelieme papierom na pečenie a zľahka postriekame olejom v spreji. Rozložíme naň zmrazené salteñas. (Nepečieme na vychladenom plechu, na ktorom sa salteñas mrazili, inak spodok cesta nezhnedne.) Pečivo potrieme bielkom a pečieme, kým spoj nesčernie a kôrka nie je zlatohnedá, 15 – 20 minút. Hneď podávame.

en.t: 1. Preheat the oven to 190 °C (fan 170 °C). Lightly grease a couple of baking sheets; or line with parchment.

2. Put the butter, water, milk, and salt in a saucepan, and heat until the butter has melted and the mixture has come to a full boil. While the mixture is heating, put 475 ml of tapioca flour into a mixing bowl.
3. Pour the boiling butter mixture over the tapioca flour, beating to combine. Beat at high speed until the mixture becomes smooth and elastic-looking; this will happen very quickly.
4. Beat the garlic and cheese into the dough until well combined.

5. Stick your finger into the dough. If it's uncomfortably hot, let it sit for a couple of minutes to cool a bit; you don't want to cook the eggs when you beat them in. If it seems hot but not burning hot, continue with the next step.

6. With the mixer going, gradually dribble in the beaten eggs, beating until well combined and smooth. We've found that tapioca starch/flour varies in its absorption capabilities. If your batter is thick but pourable, like cake or pancake batter, beat in additional tapioca flour/starch until it's thick enough to hold its shape when you scoop some onto a baking sheet. It should be the approximate consistency of cream puff batter: when you plop it onto the pan, it should settle slightly, but not spread into a puddle.

7. Drop the mixture in 2-tbsp balls (about the size of a golf ball) onto the prepared baking sheets, spacing them about 4 cm apart. A level 1-tbsp cookie scoop works well here. The buns will settle slightly as they sit.
8. Bake the buns for about 20 minutes, until they have a freckled appearance (from the browning cheese), and they're beginning to color a bit. Remove them from the oven, and serve hot.
9. Wrap any leftovers in plastic. Store at room temperature for a couple of days; freeze for longer storage. Rewarm briefly (the microwave is fine) before serving.

en.t: 1. For the Poached Chicken: In a large saucepan, add 945 ml cold water, chicken, onion, carrot, dried oregano, black peppercorns, salt, garlic, and bay leaf and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Gently simmer, adjusting heat as needed, until chicken is tender and registers 80 °C with a digital thermometer, 20 to 25 minutes.

2. Using tongs, remove the chicken from the poaching liquid and transfer to a cutting board; set aside to cool. Using a fine-mesh strainer set over a large bowl, strain the poaching liquid. Discard the strained solids and reserve the poaching liquid.

3. For the Beef Stew: In a medium bowl, whisk to combine 1 tbsp (15 ml) water with baking soda. Add the ground beef and mix to combine. Let sit for 15 minutes. In a large stainless-steel or cast iron skillet, heat 1 tbsp (15 ml) oil over high heat until shimmering. Add half of the beef and cook, without stirring, until browned on the bottom, about 3 minutes. Sprinkle with 1 tsp (5 ml) salt and, using a wooden spoon, stir and break the beef into small pieces until the beef is no longer pink, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a large bowl. Repeat with the remaining ground beef and 1 tsp (5 ml) salt, draining off excess fat from the beef and from the skillet.

4. Return the now-empty skillet to medium heat and heat the remaining 2 tbsp (30 ml) oil until shimmering. Add the onions and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 7 to 10 minutes. Stir in the cumin and paprika and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add flour and cook, stirring constantly, until no dry flour remains, about 30 seconds. Slowly whisk in 475 ml of the reserved strained poached chicken broth, scraping the bottom of the skillet to release any browned bits. Add the reserved browned beef and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Reduce heat as needed to maintain a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is thickened, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a bowl to let cool slightly before assembling.

5. For the Corn and Basil Puree: Using a high-powered blender, blend 1/2 of the corn with half of the milk and half of the basil leaves until all whole kernels are broken down and only small specs of whole basil remain. If the mixture is too thick for blending, add more milk, 1 tbsp (15 ml) at a time, as needed until it fully blends. Transfer to a bowl. Repeat with the remaining corn, milk, and basil.

6. In a large dutch oven or heavy bottomed pot, cook the butter over medium-low heat, stirring and swirling skillet constantly with rubber spatula, until milk solids have turned a light golden brown and butter has a nutty aroma, 2 to 4 minutes. As soon as the butter is browned, add the corn puree and salt and cook over medium heat, stirring frequently and making sure to scrape along the bottom of the pot to prevent scorching, until the mixture is boiling, about 15 minutes.

7. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring frequently, until the mixture is very thick and the corn is cooked through, 15 to 20 minutes. Monitor the pot closely and be careful while stirring, as the mixture will bubble and might splatter as it thickens.

8. Quickly stir the cornstarch and water slurry to recombine, then stir into the corn puree. Continue to cook until the mixture is further thickened, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer to a large heatproof bowl.

9. For Assembling: Adjust oven racks to middle position and preheat the oven at 200 °C (fan 180 °C). Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil; set aside. Spray a 23 × 33 cm baking dish with cooking spray. Cut each cooled chicken thigh in half; set aside.

10. Transfer the cooled beef stew to the bottom of the prepared baking dish and spread in an even layer. Arrange the chicken pieces, egg quarters, olives and raisins evenly spaced over the beef layer. Pour the corn puree on top and spread into an even layer, leaving about 1.5 cm space around the perimeter. Save or freeze any remaining amounts of the corn puree.
11. Sprinkle the top of the casserole with the granulated sugar and paprika. Dot the butter pieces evenly on top.

12. Place the prepared casserole on the foil-lined baking sheet and and bake until hot and bubbly throughout and well browned on top, 30 to 40 minutes. Let cool at room temperature for 15 minutes before serving.

Vo veľkej nerezovej alebo liatinovej panvici zohrejeme na silnom ohni 1¾ ČL (9 ml) oleja, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme polovicu mäsa a bez miešania opekáme, kým zospodu nezhnedne, asi 3 minúty. Posypeme 1 ČL (5 ml) soli a varechou miešame a rozdrobujeme mäso na malé kúsky, kým nie je už ružové, asi 3 minúty. Preložíme do veľkej misy. Zopakujeme so zvyšným mäsom a 1 ČL (5 ml) soli a z mäsa aj z panvice zlejeme prebytočný tuk.

4. Prázdnu panvicu vrátime na stredný oheň a zohrejeme v nej zvyšné 1¼ PL (18 ml) oleja, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme cibuľu a za častého miešania opekáme, kým nezmäkne, 7 až 10 minút. Vmiešame rímsku rascu (kmín) a mletú papriku a za stáleho miešania opekáme, kým nezavoňajú, asi 30 sekúnd. Pridáme múku a za stáleho miešania opekáme, kým nezostane žiadna suchá múka, asi 30 sekúnd. Pomaly všľaháme 475 ml odloženého precedeného vývaru z kuraťa a zoškrabeme pripečené zvyšky z dna. Pridáme odložené opečené mäso a na stredne silnom až silnom ohni privedieme do varu. Oheň podľa potreby stlmíme, aby sa zmes mierne varila, a za občasného miešania varíme, kým nezhustne, asi 10 minút. Preložíme do misy a pred skladaním necháme trochu vychladnúť.

5. **NA KUKURIČNO-BAZALKOVÉ PYRÉ:** Vo výkonnom mixéri rozmixujeme polovicu kukurice s polovicou mlieka a polovicou lístkov bazalky, kým sa nerozmixujú všetky celé zrná a nezostanú len drobné kúsky bazalky. Ak je zmes na mixovanie príliš hustá, pridávame po 1 PL (15 ml) mlieka, kým sa celá nerozmixuje. Preložíme do misy. Zopakujeme so zvyšnou kukuricou, mliekom a bazalkou.

6. Vo veľkom liatinovom alebo inom hrnci s hrubým dnom zohrievame maslo na strednom až miernom ohni za stáleho miešania gumenou stierkou a krúženia hrncom, kým mliečne bielkoviny nezískajú svetlozlatistú farbu a maslo nevonia oriešky, 2 až 4 minúty. Hneď ako maslo zhnedne, pridáme kukuričné pyré a soľ a na strednom ohni za častého miešania, pričom zoškrabujeme dno, aby sa nepripálilo, varíme, kým zmes nezovrie, asi 15 minút.

7. Keď zovrie, oheň stlmíme na mierny a za častého miešania varíme, kým zmes nie je veľmi hustá a kukurica uvarená, 15 až 20 minút. Hrniec pozorne sledujeme a miešame opatrne, lebo zmes pri hustnutí bubliny a môže prskať.
8. Zmes škrobu s vodou rýchlo premiešame a vmiešame do kukuričného pyré. Varíme ďalej, kým zmes ešte viac nezhustne, 1 až 2 minúty. Preložíme do veľkej žiaruvzdornej misy.

9. **NA SKLADANIE:** Rošt dáme do stredu rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 200 °C (teplovzdušnú na 180 °C). Plech s okrajom vystelieme alobalom; odložíme. Zapekaciu misu 23 × 33 cm postriekame olejom v spreji. Každé vychladnuté kuracie stehno rozkrojíme na polovicu; odložíme.

10. Vychladnutú hovädziu zmes preložíme na dno pripravenej misy a rozotrieme do rovnomernej vrstvy. Na mäso rovnomerne rozložíme kúsky kuraťa, štvrtky vajec, olivy a hrozienka. Navrch nalejeme kukuričné pyré a rozotrieme ho do rovnomernej vrstvy, po obvode necháme asi 1,5 cm voľného miesta. Zvyšok pyré odložíme alebo zmrazíme.
11. Povrch posypeme kryštálovým cukrom a mletou paprikou. Rovnomerne rozložíme kúsky masla.

12. Pripravenú misu postavíme na plech vystlaný alobalom a pečieme, kým nie je celá horúca, nebublá a navrchu pekne nezhnedne, 30 až 40 minút. Pred podávaním necháme 15 minút chladnúť pri izbovej teplote.

en.t: 1. To prepare the garlic: Cut off the root end of an entire head of garlic. The cloves will naturally separate to some extent. Remove the smallest clove from the head, peel, and set aside. In a small microwave-safe bowl, place the remaining garlic cloves cut-side down, then add the olive oil and water. It is OK if some of the cloves fall over into the liquid.
2. Microwave the garlic for 3 to 5 minutes at 50% power, covered, until the cloves are soft and cooked through. Set garlic aside until cool enough to handle. Reserve the cooking liquid.

3. Carefully remove the cooked garlic cloves from their skins by squeezing on the stem end, releasing the garlic into the bowl of a food processor. Use the tines of a fork to squeeze out any cloves that remain in their skins.
4. Add the peeled, uncooked garlic clove and the reserved garlic cooking liquid to the bowl of the food processor.

5. To prepare the tamal mixture: To the food processor, add about half of the corn kernels (generous or 480 g) and half of the chicken broth (scant 3 tbsp (44 ml) or 38 g), and purée until no whole kernels remain, about 1 minute, stopping once to scrape down the sides. Transfer the mixture to a medium bowl.

6. Add the remaining corn kernels, remaining chicken broth, and jalapeño slices to the bowl of a food processor (no need to wipe out). Pulse the mixture 4 to 5 times, or until very coarse, with some whole corn kernels remaining. Transfer this mixture to the medium bowl with the puréed corn mixture. Set aside.
7. In a small bowl, whisk together the masa harina, salt, baking powder, baking soda, and red pepper flakes.

8. To the bowl of a stand mixer, add the brown sugar. Using your whisk from the previous step, slowly whisk in about half of the duck fat, clarified butter, or butter (6 tbsp (72 g), 70 g to 85 g, depending on the fat used) until well mixed. It is OK if a few visible lumps of brown sugar remain. Attach your mixer’s flat beater attachment. Add the masa harina mixture and beat until the consistency resembles wet sand, about 1 minute. Scrape the bottom and sides of the bowl as needed to ensure any dry bits are incorporated. Add half the corn mixture and increase the mixer's speed to medium. Beat until smooth, about 1 minute. Stop the mixer, add the remaining corn mixture, and beat on medium speed until completely mixed, with no lumps of masa harina or brown sugar remaining.
9. Preheat the oven to 190 °C (fan 170 °C) with the rack in the middle position.

10. Set a 25 cm cast iron skillet over medium heat on the stovetop. Once hot, add the remaining duck fat, clarified butter, or butter. (Be careful if using butter, as it may spatter.) Once the fat is hot but not smoking, add the corn mixture, and spread it into a smooth layer. Without stirring, allow the mixture to cook over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes. The edges will begin to brown as the fat bubbles up between the mixture and the edges of the skillet.

c.t: 1. To prepare the garlic: Cut off the root end of an entire head of garlic. The cloves will naturally separate to some extent. Remove the smallest clove from the head, peel, and set aside. In a small microwave-safe bowl, place the remaining garlic cloves cut-side down, then add the olive oil and water. It is OK if some of the cloves fall over into the liquid.
2. Microwave the garlic for 3 to 5 minutes at 50% power, covered, until the cloves are soft and cooked through. Set garlic aside until cool enough to handle. Reserve the cooking liquid.

3. Carefully remove the cooked garlic cloves from their skins by squeezing on the stem end, releasing the garlic into the bowl of a food processor. Use the tines of a fork to squeeze out any cloves that remain in their skins.
4. Add the peeled, uncooked garlic clove and the reserved garlic cooking liquid to the bowl of the food processor.

5. To prepare the tamal mixture: To the food processor, add about half of the corn kernels (generous or 480 g) and half of the chicken broth (scant 3 tbsp (44 ml) or 38 g), and purée until no whole kernels remain, about 1 minute, stopping once to scrape down the sides. Transfer the mixture to a medium bowl.

6. Add the remaining corn kernels, remaining chicken broth, and jalapeño slices to the bowl of a food processor (no need to wipe out). Pulse the mixture 4 to 5 times, or until very coarse, with some whole corn kernels remaining. Transfer this mixture to the medium bowl with the puréed corn mixture. Set aside.
7. In a small bowl, whisk together the masa harina, salt, baking powder, baking soda, and red pepper flakes.

8. To the bowl of a stand mixer, add the brown sugar. Using your whisk from the previous step, slowly whisk in about half of the duck fat, clarified butter, or butter (6 tbsp (72 g), 70 g to 85 g, depending on the fat used) until well mixed. It is OK if a few visible lumps of brown sugar remain. Attach your mixer’s flat beater attachment. Add the masa harina mixture and beat until the consistency resembles wet sand, about 1 minute. Scrape the bottom and sides of the bowl as needed to ensure any dry bits are incorporated. Add half the corn mixture and increase the mixer's speed to medium. Beat until smooth, about 1 minute. Stop the mixer, add the remaining corn mixture, and beat on medium speed until completely mixed, with no lumps of masa harina or brown sugar remaining.
9. Preheat the oven to 190 °C (fan 170 °C) with the rack in the middle position.

10. Set a 25 cm cast iron skillet over medium heat on the stovetop. Once hot, add the remaining duck fat, clarified butter, or butter. (Be careful if using butter, as it may spatter.) Once the fat is hot but not smoking, add the corn mixture, and spread it into a smooth layer. Without stirring, allow the mixture to cook over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes. The edges will begin to brown as the fat bubbles up between the mixture and the edges of the skillet.

11. Cover the skillet with aluminum foil, transfer to the oven, and bake for 30 minutes. Remove aluminum foil and cook for another 5 to 8 minutes, or until the top turns light golden brown color in a few places. Remove from the oven and serve warm.
12. Storage information: Store leftover skillet corn tamal in an airtight container in the refrigerator up to 4 days.

1. **PRÍPRAVA CESNAKU:** Z celej hlavičky cesnaku odrežeme koreňovú časť. Strúčiky sa čiastočne samy oddelia. Najmenší strúčik vyberieme, ošúpeme a odložíme. Zvyšné strúčiky dáme do malej misky vhodnej do mikrovlnnej rúry reznou stranou nadol a pridáme olivový olej a vodu. Nevadí, ak niektoré strúčiky spadnú do tekutiny.

2. Cesnak zohrievame v mikrovlnnej rúre prikrytý 3 až 5 minút na 50 % výkonu, kým strúčiky nezmäknú a nie sú prepečené. Necháme postáť, kým nevychladne natoľko, aby sme ho mohli chytiť. Tekutinu odložíme.
3. Upečené strúčiky opatrne vytlačíme zo šupiek stlačením pri stopke priamo do nádoby kuchynského robota. Strúčiky, ktoré zostanú v šupke, vytlačíme hrotmi vidličky.
4. Do nádoby kuchynského robota pridáme ošúpaný surový strúčik a odloženú tekutinu z cesnaku.

5. **PRÍPRAVA TAMALOVEJ ZMESI:** Do kuchynského robota pridáme asi polovicu kukuričných zŕn (vrchovato, 480 g) a polovicu kuracieho vývaru (necelé 3 PL (44 ml), 38 g) a rozmixujeme, kým nezostanú žiadne celé zrná, asi 1 minútu; raz zastavíme a zotrieme steny. Zmes preložíme do strednej misy.

6. Do nádoby kuchynského robota (netreba ju vytierať) dáme zvyšnú kukuricu, zvyšný kurací vývar a plátky jalapeña. Pulzne premiešame 4- až 5-krát, kým zmes nie je veľmi hrubá a zostanú v nej celé zrná. Preložíme ju do strednej misy k rozmixovanej kukurici. Odložíme.
7. V malej miske metličkou zmiešame masa harina, soľ, kypriaci prášok do pečiva, jedlú sódu a čili vločky.

8. Do misy kuchynského robota dáme hnedý cukor. Metličkou z predchádzajúceho kroku doň pomaly zapracujeme asi polovicu kačacej masti, prepusteného masla alebo masla (6 PL (72 g), 70 až 85 g podľa druhu tuku), kým nie je dobre premiešaný. Nevadí, ak zostane zopár viditeľných hrudiek cukru. Nasadíme plochú miešaciu metlu. Pridáme zmes s masa harina a šľaháme, kým zmes nepripomína mokrý piesok, asi 1 minútu. Podľa potreby zotrieme dno a steny misy, aby sa zapracovali všetky suché zvyšky. Pridáme polovicu kukuričnej zmesi a rýchlosť zvýšime na strednú. Šľaháme dohladka, asi 1 minútu. Robot zastavíme, pridáme zvyšnú kukuričnú zmes a na strednej rýchlosti šľaháme, kým nie je všetko dokonale premiešané, bez hrudiek masa harina či cukru.
9. Rošt dáme do stredu rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 190 °C (teplovzdušnú na 170 °C).

10. Liatinovú panvicu s priemerom 25 cm postavíme na sporák na stredný oheň. Keď je horúca, pridáme zvyšnú kačaciu masť, prepustené maslo alebo maslo. (Pri masle opatrne, môže prskať.) Keď je tuk horúci, ale nedymí, pridáme kukuričnú zmes a rozotrieme ju do hladkej vrstvy. Bez miešania ju necháme na strednom ohni 4 až 5 minút opekať. Okraje začnú hnednúť, keď medzi zmesou a stenami panvice začne bublať tuk.

11. Panvicu prikryjeme alobalom, preložíme do rúry a pečieme 30 minút. Alobal odstránime a pečieme ďalších 5 až 8 minút, kým povrch miestami nezíska svetlozlatistú farbu. Vyberieme z rúry a podávame teplé.
12. **SKLADOVANIE:** Zvyšný kukuričný tamal z panvice uchováme vo vzduchotesnej nádobe v chladničke najviac 4 dni.

1. Sušené papričky ancho a guajillo rozložíme na tanier vhodný do mikrovlnnej rúry a zohrievame, kým nie sú ohybné a nevoňajú opražene, 10 až 20 sekúnd. Preložíme ich do nádoby mixéra a pridáme papričky chipotle, pomarančovú šťavu, limetkovú šťavu, olivový olej, sójovú omáčku, rybaciu omáčku, hnedý cukor, koriandrovú vňať, cesnak, celú rímsku rascu (kmín) a koriandrové semienka. Rozmixujeme na hladkú omáčku, asi 1 minútu. Podľa chuti osolíme. Polovicu salsy preložíme do veľkej misy a druhú polovicu do uzatvárateľnej nádoby. Nádobu odložíme do chladničky.

2. Do salsy v mise pridáme ďalšie 2 ČL (10 ml) soli. Mala by byť o niečo slanšia, ako je príjemné. Do misy vložíme jeden kus steaku a obalíme ho. Preložíme ho do 4-litrového uzatvárateľného vrecka s prehnutým horným okrajom, aby sa uzáver nezašpinil omáčkou a šťavou z mäsa. Zopakujeme so zvyšnými steakmi a všetky dáme do toho istého vrecka. Zvyšok marinády nalejeme na steaky. Z vrecka vytlačíme všetok vzduch a uzavrieme ho. Dáme do chladničky aspoň na 3 a najviac na 12 hodín.

3. Pred grilovaním vyberieme odloženú salsu z chladničky, aby sa trochu zohriala. Rozpálime jeden komín plný dreveného uhlia. Keď je všetko uhlie rozžeravené a pokryté sivým popolom, vysypeme ho a rozložíme na jednu stranu roštu na uhlie. Vložíme grilovací rošt, gril prikryjeme a necháme 5 minút rozohriať. Prípadne na plynovom grile nastavíme polovicu horákov na najvyšší výkon, prikryjeme a necháme 10 minút rozohriať. Grilovací rošt očistíme a potrieme olejom.

4. Steaky vyberieme z marinády a zotrieme prebytok. Položíme ich priamo nad horúcu stranu grilu. Plynový gril prikryjeme, gril na drevené uhlie necháme odkrytý. en.t: 1. For the Soup: Heat pumpkin seeds in the base of a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat, stirring constantly, until they start to pop and smell nutty, about 4 minutes. Transfer pumpkin seeds to a bowl and set aside.

2. Add chicken, tomatillos, onion, peppers, chicken stock, oregano, epazote (if using), and a large pinch of salt to the Dutch oven. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a bare simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until chicken and vegetables are completely tender, about 40 minutes.

3. Using tongs, transfer chicken to a large plate or bowl and set aside. Discard epazote sprigs (if using). Set a large fine-mesh strainer over a large bowl and strain the broth through it. Transfer solids to the jar of a blender. Add pumpkin seeds and cilantro to the blender. Blend on high speed until smooth. Set aside.

4. Using a ladle, carefully skim off a few tbsp of fat from the strained stock and add it to the Dutch oven (it's okay if a little stock gets in as well). Heat over high heat, swirling and stirring until the watery stock completely evaporates and starts to form a browned layer in the bottom of the pan. (It will spatter a bit. The more you stir, the less it will spatter.) As soon as the chicken fat starts to smoke, pour in the contents of the blender all at once and cook, stirring, for about 15 seconds (it will spatter a lot—wear an apron!). Immediately pour in strained chicken stock and fat and stir to combine. Bring to a bare simmer, stir in hominy, season to taste with salt, and keep warm.
5. By this stage, the chicken should be cool enough to handle. Discard the skin and bones and shred the meat into bite-size pieces with your fingertips. Stir the picked chicken back into the soup.
6. To Serve: Ladle the hot soup into bowls and garnish with diced avocado and radish, sliced chiles, chopped cilantro, and chopped white onion. Serve immediately.

1. **NA POLIEVKU:** Na dne veľkého liatinového hrnca pražíme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni za stáleho miešania tekvicové semienka, kým nezačnú praskať a voňať oriešky, asi 4 minúty. Semienka preložíme do misky a odložíme.

2. Do hrnca dáme kura, tomatillos, cibuľu, papričky, kurací vývar, oregano, epazote (ak ho používame) a veľkú štipku soli. Na silnom ohni privedieme do varu, potom stlmíme, aby sa polievka sotva varila. Za občasného miešania varíme, kým kura a zelenina nie sú úplne mäkké, asi 40 minút.

3. Kliešťami preložíme kura na veľký tanier alebo do misy a odložíme. Vetvičky epazote (ak sme ich použili) vyhodíme. Na veľkú misu postavíme veľké jemné sitko a vývar ním precedíme. Pevné časti preložíme do nádoby mixéra. Pridáme tekvicové semienka a koriandrovú vňať. Rozmixujeme na vysokých otáčkach dohladka. Odložíme.

4. Naberačkou opatrne zoberieme z precedeného vývaru niekoľko PL tuku a dáme ho do liatinového hrnca (nevadí, ak sa pridá aj trochu vývaru). Zohrievame na silnom ohni, krúžime a miešame, kým sa vodnatý vývar úplne neodparí a na dne hrnca sa nezačne tvoriť hnedá vrstva. (Bude trochu prskať; čím viac miešame, tým menej prská.) Hneď ako kurací tuk začne dymiť, nalejeme naraz celý obsah mixéra a za miešania varíme asi 15 sekúnd (bude veľmi prskať – oblečieme si zásteru!). Hneď nalejeme precedený kurací vývar s tukom a premiešame. Privedieme do sotva viditeľného varu, vmiešame hominy (lúhovanú kukuricu), podľa chuti osolíme a udržiavame teplé.
5. Teraz by malo byť kura dosť vychladnuté, aby sme ho mohli chytiť. Kožu a kosti vyhodíme a mäso natrháme prstami na kúsky veľkosti sústa. Obrané kura vmiešame späť do polievky.
6. **NA PODÁVANIE:** Horúcu polievku naberieme do misiek a ozdobíme nakrájaným avokádom a reďkovkou, plátkami čili papričiek, nasekanou koriandrovou vňaťou a nasekanou bielou cibuľou. Hneď podávame.
